headline: Gold and silver fall sharply again; 24K gold now ₹12,458 per gram
summary: Today's change is a drop of ₹322 per gram for 24K gold (about 2.52%), and silver fell ₹10,000 per kg (about 5.71%) to ₹1,65,000. Over the last 7 days, 24K gold is down about 6.51% and silver about 10.81%, and across the 31 days shown, gold is down about 12.73% and silver about 25% from its high of ₹2,20,000 on 26 October. Possible drivers include the US dollar and rupee movements, and international spot prices, which are also lower today, though the data here does not confirm the specific cause.
outlook: Prices have fallen steadily for weeks, so if you are not buying urgently, it may be sensible to compare rates across a few jewellers and factor in making charges and GST before deciding.
